inventory.sourceFigureDescription: A structured marker table by cell: T cells (TCR, CD3, CD28 with functions); Helper T cells (CD4, CD40L, CXCR4/CCR5 as HIV coreceptors); Cytotoxic T cells (CD8); Regulatory T cells (CD4, CD25); B cells (Ig, CD19, CD20, CD21 EBV receptor, CD40, MHC II, B7); NK cells (CD16 Fc-of-IgG, CD56); Macrophages (CD14 PAMP/LPS receptor, CD40, CCR5, MHC II, B7, Fc and C3b receptors); Hematopoietic stem cells (CD34).
